reviewer.role: independent reviewer of the one-line workflow correction; not its implementer

scope: Interpreter-project selection for the existing Boolean-rank CI logger invocation only. No product, mathematical, source, solver, or claim re-evaluation was performed.

findings.statement: The scoped Git diff is exactly one deleted line and one added line. It removes only '--project experiments/msc-index' from the outer uv invocation. The logger path, attempt ID, timeout, log directory, Node checker command, functional-result path, and artifact-upload block are unchanged.

The retained GitHub failure is explained by interpreter selection before the logger started: CI supplied Python 3.13, while the selected MSC subproject requires Python 3.12. The checker therefore did not execute and the always-run upload step found no files.

From the repository-root working directory, the corrected outer uv command selects the root project, whose Python requirement accepts 3.13. The invoked logger imports only Python standard-library modules, and its child remains the same audited Node checker, so no MSC rdflib dependency is needed for this step.

The current logger and checker hashes equal their artifacts in the reviewed bundle. The local smoke record has a zero return code, no timeout and empty stderr, and its functional result reports passed. This supports the correction but is not a substitute for execution by GitHub on the corrected exact commit.

The reviewed bundle hash exactly equals the prior evidence-kind correction's recorded after_sha256. That earlier correction only attached already-reviewed direct evidence and explicitly left claim and semantic-check content unchanged.

limitations: Actual corrected GitHub CI remains required as the operational execution evidence.
The local smoke attempt record does not retain UV_PYTHON in selected_environment, so this review does not independently attest the root-reported local interpreter version from that record alone.
This acknowledgment does not alter or recertify the seven product, mathematical, source, or status claims.

may_append: this exact acknowledgment as a new audit artifact
the retained failed-GitHub-run log as failure evidence
the local smoke attempt and result as explicitly limited supplementary evidence
authorized_bundle_mutation.check_evidence_arrays: The new acknowledgment artifact ID may be appended as supplemental evidence to each existing check evidence array; it must not replace the existing direct code, specification, source, or result evidence.
must_remain_unchanged: all seven claim IDs, statements, types, statuses, supports and locators
all product and source artifacts other than the A111 hash update

final_condition: Promotion of this correction as executed in GitHub is contingent on a corrected exact-commit GitHub run reaching the checker and producing the retained functional/log artifacts.
